Name: Imagical Animal Theme Music Framework
Author: imagicalfantasy
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Imagical Animal Theme Music[/b][/size][/center]
[center]A framework for custom barn & coop background music[/center]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Per-animal music (different tracks for each animal type)
[*] Day/Night variations (awake vs sleeping animals)
[*] Seasonal overrides (spring, summer, fall, winter)
[*] Priority system (highest priority wins if multiple animals are present)
[*] Restore previous track when leaving
[*] Content Patcher support for easy configuration
[/list]
[size=5][b]📦 What this mod does NOT do[/b][/size]
This is a [b]framework[/b]. By itself, it won't change any music.
You need a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] pack or custom patch.

[size=5][b]⚙️ Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] (Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list]
[size=5][b]📖 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*] Download and extract this mod into your Mods folder.
[*]Install a content pack that defines music cues.
[*] Launch the game and enjoy!
[/list]
[size=5][b]🛡️ Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] Multiplayer safe (each player handles their own barn music)
[*] Compatible with most music mods
[/list]
[size=5][b]📑 Example: Content Patcher configuration[/b][/size]
Here’s how you can define custom music for animals with Content Patcher:

[code]
{
"Changes": [
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/AudioChanges",
"Entries": {
"cow_day_theme": {
"ID": "cow_day_theme",
"Category": "Music",
"FilePaths": [
"{{AbsoluteFilePath: music/cow_day_theme.ogg}}"
],
"StreamedVorbis": true,
"Looped": true
},
"cow_night_theme": {
"ID": "cow_night_theme",
"Category": "Music",
"FilePaths": [
"{{AbsoluteFilePath: music/cow_night_theme.ogg}}"
],
"StreamedVorbis": true,
"Looped": true
}
}
},
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Imagical.AnimalThemeMusic/Musics",
"Entries": {
"CowGroup": {
"MusicCue": "cow_day_theme",
"MusicCueSleeping": "cow_night_theme",
"MusicMode": "RestoreAfter",
"Entities": [
"White Cow",
"Brown Cow"
]
},
"PigGroup": {
"MusicMode": "RestoreAfter",
"Entities": [
"Pig"
],
"Seasons": {
"Spring": {
"MusicCue": "spring1",
"MusicCueSleeping": "spring1"
},
"Summer": {
"MusicCue": "abigailflute",
"MusicCueSleeping": "abigailflute"
},
"Fall": {
"MusicCue": "breezy",
"MusicCueSleeping": "breezy"
},
"Winter": {
"MusicCue": "winter1",
"MusicCueSleeping": "winter1"
}
}
}
}
}
]
}
[/code]
